title: Ops cadence KPI & staffing tiltboard (experimental)
description: Working spreadsheet that combines launch KPIs, short-term staffing allocation (tiltboard), acceptance gates, and a compact contingency budget. Goal: provide a single-pane daily operational view for a 6‑week pilot and one production ramp. Not final; asks product, SRE, and staffing to sign off.
kpi_rows: KPI: api_p95_latency_ms, Goal: <= 250ms, Baseline: 340ms, Measurement cadence: 15m
KPI: api_error_rate_pct, Goal: <0.5%, Baseline: 1.8%, Measurement cadence: 5m
KPI: cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, Goal: < $0.40, Baseline: $0.62, Notes: includes caching savings
KPI: dedicated_gpu_utilization_pct, Goal: 60-85%, Baseline: 45%, Measurement cadence: 1h
KPI: canary_failure_rate_pct, Goal: 0%, Baseline: 0.4%, Rollout trigger: >0.2% x 10min
KPI: retention_d1_pct, Goal: >= 28%, Baseline: 22%, Cohort: onboarding flow A
KPI: eval_regression_count, Goal: 0 new regressions, Baseline: 1 last week, Source: nightly-evals
KPI: sso_slo_burn_pct, Goal: <= 5% burn/day, Baseline: 9% during stress test
tiltboard_rows: Tilt axis: staffing (x) vs latency budget (y)
Mode A (customer-first): +2 infra on-call (12h/day) => reduce p95 by ~35ms, cost +8%
Mode B (cost-first): delay extra on-call, tweak batching => latency +20ms, cost -6%
Mode C (balanced): 1 infra on-call + 1 ops rotation + dynamic batching => p95 stable, cost +1%
Decision rule: if api_error_rate > 1% AND p95 > 300ms for 30m => escalate to Mode A
rollout_timeline: Week 0: internal pilot feature flag, smoke tests, canary build 0.1
Week 1: gated beta (5% traffic), run 48h latency soak, capture analytics hooks
Week 2: expand to 20% traffic, enable dedicated pooling for heavy routes
Week 3: full beta (75%), begin auto-scaling tuning and quantization trials
Week 4: GA decision window, cross-check eval regressions and cost delta
Week 5-6: ramp to 100% with staged traffic shift + staffing rotation cadence
staffing_plan: Infra on-call: primary (M-F 9a-6p) - Diego Alvarez; secondary nights/weekend - Hannah Li
Support rotations: 2x product ops (08:00-20:00 PST) - Priya N., Alan K.
SRE deep-dive crew: 1x SRE + 1x ML infra dedicated during canary windows (Week1, Week3)
On-the-ground outage SLA: 30 minutes to triage, 90 minutes to mitigation plan
go_no_go_checklist: API p95 under goal for 48h rolling window
No new eval regressions in last 7 nightly runs
Dedicated GPU pool reachable from prod region endpoints
Smoke canary passed for request sampling (5k requests) without functional errors
Incident runbook updated and acknowledged by on-call team
Cost projection delta (next 30d) within approved budget +/- 12%
acceptance_criteria: Functional: all public API routes return 200 for canonical prompts
Quality: top-level eval metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-like) show no negative drift
Observability: tracing + sampling logs integrated into console dashboards
Security: key rotation and KMS integration validated in staging
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: sudden traffic spike saturates KV cache leading to p95 spike; Mitigation: pre-warm cache via synthetic load and enable prefix caching for heavy routes
Risk: quantization introduces hallucination regressions; Mitigation: run targeted evals on prompt set and keep fallback model unquantized for critical routes
Risk: staffing fatigue during 72h soak; Mitigation: staggered rotations + paid overtime budget line + on-call handoff checklist
Risk: underestimated cost growth from churn; Mitigation: daily cost burn monitoring and automated throttle at 2x budget threshold
escalation_contacts: Primary Eng Lead: Diego Alvarez - diego@redwood.ai
Customer Success Oncall: Priya Natarajan - priya@redwood.ai
notes: This sheet intentionally keeps KPI windows short (15m-24h) for active launches. The tiltboard rows are experimental framing to force tradeoff decisions between cost and latency.
